head: 4ee7760ffc3ee0840dac87d739eabe791a8c311d
roundNote: Round 12 tests the answer to round 11 and the architect's scope (Envoy 86d49bda). c50be619 deletes the four daemon fragments: this PR's and main's three orphans. a02ce346 lays out scripts/conflicts/README.md. 7fbb983f adds refuse_unlisted to release-push.sh fold-plan, runs changelog-fold.yaml's fold_build on any PR that touches packages/*/.changes/**, adds the tests and adds one AGENTS.md line. It also answers the architect's two questions (Envoy 9e49f4e0): (A) does the refusal stop a PR before the merge, and (B) does an orphan on main now stop the whole fold. Migrations and scripts/conflicts code are unchanged since round 11, so its proofs of them still apply.

implementerProof.how: The three items hold where I drove them. No packages/daemon/.changes remains, and c50be619 deletes exactly those 4 files. The README carries the note and passes the layout checker; a word-level diff shows only the note added and the flags table turned into a list. release-push.test.sh passes 628/0, and with the refuse_unlisted call removed 3 of its new checks fail, so the tests pin the refusal. The proof is right about what fold-plan does. It does not cover where fold-plan runs, which is both of the architect's questions, and both fail.

failures.criterion: (A) The orphan-fragment refusal stops a pull request before the merge (architect, Envoy 9e49f4e0: a required check must go red on a branch that adds packages/daemon/.changes/unreleased/x.yaml)
failures.evidence: The refusal runs only in changelog-fold.yaml's fold_build job (workflow 'Fold Changelog Fragments'). gh api repos/sjawhar/legion/rulesets: ruleset 12331919 'main' (branch, active) requires exactly two contexts, ci-ok and pr-title. There is no branch protection to read beyond it (403 to this App). ci-ok is ci.yaml's aggregate of ci.yaml's own jobs, and its needs block mentions no fold or changelog job (awk over the block: 0 matches); a job cannot need a job of another workflow. On this head GitHub lists fold_build as its own check run (https://github.com/sjawhar/legion/actions/runs/41171920695/job/124451503859), apart from ci-ok and pr-title. ci.yaml runs release-push.test.sh, the script's unit tests over fixtures, not fold-plan over the repository's tree. Driven: a branch off 7fbb983f that adds packages/daemon/.changes/unreleased/x.yaml makes fold-plan exit 1 with the ::error:: naming the file, so fold_build would be red, but neither required context runs it, and the merge is not blocked. The gate does not gate. Fix, as the architect named it: run the same refusal in a job the base branch requires. I wrote no permanent red test for this one: it would have to assert what a workflow file contains, a check of a check, and the ruleset read plus the driven branch are the evidence.

failures.criterion: (B) An orphan fragment that reaches main does not stop the fold of the packages it can fold, and is named (architect, Envoy 9e49f4e0)
failures.evidence: changelog-fold.yaml's 'Plan the fold' step runs plan=$(.github/scripts/release-push.sh fold-plan $CHANGELOG_PACKAGES), so a non-zero exit fails fold_build, and fold_publish (needs: fold_build) does not run. Driven on real trees with the CHANGELOG_PACKAGES list: at 7fbb983f, clean, fold-plan exits 0 and plans 23 fragments of 7 packages; with one commit adding packages/daemon/.changes/unreleased/x.yaml it exits 1 and prints no plan ('::error::release-push.sh fold-plan: packages/daemon/.changes/unreleased/x.yaml at HEAD: each is under the .changes/ of a package the fold was not given…'). The previous code, 710f02a2, with the same added file exits 0 and plans the same 23 fragments of 7 packages. So one orphan on main now stops every package's fold: a regression. Red test, its own commit a26683995f0f: .github/scripts/release-push.test.sh check 'fold-plan: an orphan fragment on main does not stop the plan of the packages the fold is given', in the implementer's fold-orphan fixture while the daemon fragment is present. It expects exit 0, the envoy plan line, and stderr naming packages/daemon/.changes/unreleased/pr-1-daemon.yaml. Command: bash .github/scripts/release-push.test.sh, which fails with 'FAIL: fold-plan: an orphan fragment on main does not stop the plan of the packages the fold is given', Results 628 passed, 1 failed. Under 710f02a2 the fixture gives exit 0 and the plan but an empty stderr, so the test needs both halves: the fold continues and the orphan is named. The implementer's own check 'a fragment of a package no spec names is refused by name, with no plan' asserts the opposite of the required behaviour and is theirs to change.
